```yaml
name: Regenerate Sonar API spec

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * *'  # 06:00 UTC daily
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  regenerate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: '**/pnpm-lock.yaml'

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm@9.4.0

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Obtain Octavia Bot token
        id: octavia
        uses: DataDog/dd-octo-sts-action@acaa02eee7e3bb0839e4272dacb37b8f3b58ba80
        with:
          domain: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          audience: ${{ github.repository }}
          scope: repo
          policy: |
            {
              "Version":"2012-10-17",
              "Statement":[
                {
                  "Effect":"Allow",
                  "Action":["repo:status","repo:pull_request","repo:push","repo:contents"],
                  "Resource":"*"
                }
              ]
            }
        env:
          OCTAVIA_BOT_APP_ID: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_APP_ID }}
          OCTAVIA_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Set GITHUB_TOKEN for subsequent steps
        run: echo "GITHUB_TOKEN=${{ steps.octavia.outputs.token }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Regenerate Sonar API spec
        run: node scripts/prepare-embedded-api-spec.js

      - name: Format with Prettier
        run: pnpm prettier --write .

      - name: Stage changes
        run: git add .

      - name: Check for changes
        id: diff
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create PR if changes exist
        if: steps.diff.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ env.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: regenerate Sonar API spec"
          branch: regenerate-sonar-api-spec
          title: "chore: regenerate Sonar API spec"
          body: |
            This PR updates the Sonar API spec documentation to the latest version.
          labels: auto-merge, autogenerated, documentation
          base: main
          delete-branch: true
```
